topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Ran into an old face today, a stranger not so strange, someone you can't quite place but there's a spark, a bit like finding a half-remembered song on the radio. Had a long talk, over a cup of coffee that seemed to stretch on. Funny, the world, small and big all at once. There's a touch of the unexpected, a surprise that lights up the gray of the day. Not a word out of place, but the kind of silence that's worth speaking volumes. Got me thinking, about time and how it does strange things to the heart. Maybe some doors don’t stay closed, just change the view from the other side. Guess we’ll see where this road takes us, but for now, it’s nice to have company.
